T: Three tasks. One ball. Plenty of food.
D: Harry is entered into a dangerous tournament between three schools of magic.
P: Serve the feast at the Yule Ball.
S: Sticky pan fried sausages and golden onions in soft rolls with brown sauce
Pork sausages fried slowly in a heavy pan until sticky, in soft rolls with fried onions and brown sauce.
the Yule Ball in the Great Hall

Warm buckwheat blinis topped with crème fraîche, smoked salmon, dill, lemon zest and a little salmon roe, laid out on silver trays. Whisk 100g buckwheat flour, 50g plain flour, 1 tsp baking powder and a pinch of salt with 200ml milk and 1 egg into a thick batter. Cook teaspoons in a buttered pan for 1 minute a side to make about 30 blinis. Cool slightly. Top each with a little crème fraîche, a curl of smoked salmon, a sprig of dill, lemon zest and a few beads of salmon roe.
Crisp chorizo glazed with honey and chili, on toothpicks with cheddar
Chorizo cooked in a hot pan with honey and chilli flakes until sticky, on toothpicks with cubes of sharp cheddar.
M: Rib roast with roast potatoes, Yorkshire puddings and honey glazed carrots
Beef rib roast roasted at 220C then 160C to 52C, rested, with roast potatoes, Yorkshire puddings, honey carrots and red wine gravy.

Snapper, mussels and prawns simmered in a saffron, fennel and tomato broth, with toasted baguette and a garlicky red rouille to stir through. Soften 1 onion, 1 fennel bulb and 4 garlic cloves in olive oil. Add a pinch of saffron, 1 strip orange zest, 1 tin crushed tomatoes and 1.2 litres fish stock and simmer 20 minutes. Add 600g snapper chunks for 3 minutes, then 500g mussels and 8 green prawns for 4 minutes until opened. Blend 1 roasted capsicum, 2 garlic cloves, 2 tbsp breadcrumbs, a pinch of chilli and 80ml olive oil for rouille. Serve with toasted baguette.
W: Crisp meringue with a soft center, topped with whipped cream
Meringue baked at 120C for 90 minutes, cooled in the oven, topped with cream, white chocolate shavings and berries dusted with icing sugar like frost.
K: Apple juice simmered with cinnamon, cloves, orange peel and star anise, served warm
Cloudy apple juice simmered with cinnamon, cloves, orange peel and star anise for 15 minutes, served warm.

steps.text: Fry the sausages slowly in a heavy pan until sticky.
Fry the onions in the butter until golden.
Fill the rolls with sausage and onions and add a good squirt of brown sauce.
Fry the chorizo in a hot pan until crisp.
Add the honey and chilli flakes and cook until sticky.
Spear onto toothpicks with cubes of cheddar.

dishes.make_ahead: Gravy and carrots can be made 1 hour ahead

steps.text: Heat the oven to 220C. Season the beef and roast for the first stage.
Drop the oven to 160C and roast the beef until 52C in the middle.
Roast the potatoes in oil alongside the beef.
Whisk the eggs, flour and milk and bake Yorkshires in hot oiled tins at 220C.
Glaze the carrots with honey and roast.
Make gravy by simmering the red wine with the pan juices.

dishes.make_ahead: Base up to 1 day, top just before serving

steps.text: Heat the oven to 120C. Whip the egg whites to soft peaks, add the sugar gradually until glossy, then fold in the cornflour.
Shape on baking paper and bake for 90 minutes.
Turn off the oven and cool the pavlova inside.
Top with whipped cream, white chocolate and berries, dusted with icing sugar.

dishes.make_ahead: Up to 2 days, reheat to serve

steps.text: Simmer the apple juice with the cinnamon, cloves, orange peel and star anise.
Strain and serve warm in mugs.

s.note: Sticky pan fried sausages and golden onions in soft rolls with brown sauce
s.how: Fry 8 pork sausages slowly in a heavy pan until sticky. Fry 2 sliced onions in butter until golden. Put in 8 soft rolls with the onions and a good squirt of brown sauce.

s.note: Crisp chorizo glazed with honey and chili, on toothpicks with cheddar
s.how: Slice 300g chorizo and fry in a hot pan until crisp. Add 2 tbsp honey and a pinch of chilli flakes and cook until sticky. Spear on toothpicks with cubes of 150g sharp cheddar.

m.note: Rib roast with roast potatoes, Yorkshire puddings and honey glazed carrots
m.how: Roast a 2kg beef rib roast at 220C for 20 minutes then 160C to 52C and rest. Roast 1kg potatoes. Bake Yorkshires from 3 eggs, 150g flour and 300ml milk at 220C. Glaze 4 carrots with honey. Make gravy with 200ml red wine.

w.note: Crisp meringue with a soft center, topped with whipped cream
w.how: Whip 4 whites to soft peaks, add 220g caster sugar until glossy, then fold in 1 tsp cornflour. Bake at 120C for 90 minutes and cool in the oven. Top with 300ml whipped cream, 50g white chocolate shavings and 250g berries dusted with icing sugar.

d.note: Apple juice simmered with cinnamon, cloves, orange peel and star anise, served warm
d.how: Simmer 1.5L cloudy apple juice with 2 cinnamon sticks, 6 cloves, orange peel and 2 star anise for 15 minutes. Strain and serve warm in mugs.
